retrievalProfile.description: A vertical split-screen layout featuring a high-contrast fashion subject on a textured teal background paired with a distressed typographic column on cream paper.

recipe.visualDefinition: A two-panel composition where the left third is a vertical strip of aged, speckled cream paper containing stacked typography, and the right two-thirds features a subject in a dynamic squatting pose against a heavily textured, gradient teal and yellow background with visible film grain and scratches.
coreVisualRelationships: Vertical division between textured paper and vibrant photographic background
Contrast between the sharp, dark subject and the bright, weathered surroundings
Alignment of typographic blocks to create a balanced vertical weight on the left
coreInvariants: Heavy paper grain and distressed surface textures across both panels
High-contrast lighting on the subject with deep blacks and bright highlights
A palette dominated by cream, teal, and deep black

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: Subject is positioned in the right two-thirds, scaled to fill the vertical height from heels to hair.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The subject's dark clothing and central squatting form act as the primary anchor.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: Eyes start at the large top text on the left, move down through the subtitle and main title, then transition to the subject's face and follow the body line down to the heels.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: Negative space is active and textured, providing breathing room around the subject and text.

colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: High saturation in the background teal/yellow gradient contrasted with desaturated, high-value skin tones and low-value black clothing.

letterConstructionRules: Extreme vertical elongation for the top display text
Rough, eroded edges and internal distressing for the main title
High-contrast thick and thin strokes for the script subtitle
characterSpecificRedesigns: The 'I' in the top text is replaced with a stylized exclamation mark
Main title letters feature irregular 'dripping' or 'torn' bottom edges
typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: Triadic pairing of ultra-condensed sans, elegant script, and heavy distressed slab-serif.

candidateDirections.reason: Captures the ultra-condensed, bold feel of the top display text.
Matches the punk, distressed aesthetic of the main title.

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: Generate a split-screen image: left 1/3 is aged cream paper with heavy speckles; right 2/3 is a teal-to-yellow gradient background with film grain. In the right panel, place a subject in a squatting pose wearing black clothing and red heels, styled with high-contrast lighting.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Apply three distinct text blocks to the left panel: a tall condensed sans-serif at the top, a small elegant script in the middle, and a heavy distressed slab-serif stacked at the bottom. All text should be black with slight weathering.

verificationChecks: Is the layout split vertically into 1/3 cream and 2/3 teal?
Does the typography show visible distressing and erosion?
Is the subject in a high-contrast, dynamic squatting pose?
Are the textures (grain, scratches, speckles) consistent across the image?

mustRedesign: Exact facial features of the subject
postGenerationChecks: Verify the 'I' replacement in the top text is present.
Ensure the teal background has a visible yellow gradient at the bottom.
Check that the text on the left is perfectly centered within its panel.
Confirm the red accent color is limited to the shoes and lips.
recipe.reuseFormula: Combine [Vertical Split Layout] with [Distressed Punk Typography] and [High-Contrast Fashion Photography] under a [Vintage Film Grain Overlay].
